AI Boom Increases Tech Firms' Carbon Emissions, Report Finds

The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is significantly increasing the carbon footprint of major technology companies, according to a new report. Emissions from four leading AI and cloud computing providers surged by up to 239% between 2020 and 2024. This trend is challenging the climate pledges made by these firms.
